description: This file defines a class 'ForLoopNode' used internally by the Twig templating engine to represent and compile 'for' loop structures within templates. It extends the Node class, providing logic for updating loop-related context variables during template compilation.

classes.name: ForLoopNode
classes.description: Represents a 'for' loop node within Twig's internal representation, handling compilation of loop-specific context updates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ForLoopNode with the current line number, setting default attributes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates the PHP code for updating loop context variables based on node attributes during template compilation.
